scope_policy: Numeric replay supports only row-level bounded QA claims. Exact official snapshot rows are quarantined from prediction/empirical promotion.

rows.claim_scope: calibration replay of an official constant, not a new law of physics
rows.formula: predicted c = SI defining value parsed from NIST CODATA snapshot
rows.negative_control: replace c by 300000000 and residual becomes nonzero
rows.falsifier: NIST snapshot parse does not yield 299792458 m s^-1
rows.quarantine_reason: exact definitional snapshot replay; QA only, not a prediction

rows.claim_scope: PubChem molecular-weight field replay for water only
rows.formula: predicted molecular weight = pinned PubChem MolecularWeight field parsed from official snapshot
rows.split_policy: snapshot field replay only; no held-out formula-derived chemistry claim
rows.negative_control: use CO2 molecular-weight field against water snapshot and require mismatch
rows.falsifier: PubChem snapshot parser cannot recover MolecularWeight=18.015 for CID 962
rows.quarantine_reason: official field replay; QA only, not a formula-derived prediction

rows.claim_scope: official GEO query-count replay; no organism-wide mechanism claim
rows.formula: predicted count = pinned ESearch count recorded in snapshot
rows.split_policy: snapshot replay only; mechanism claim not promoted
rows.negative_control: query a different accession and require count mismatch
rows.falsifier: replay parser cannot recover the pinned count
rows.quarantine_reason: exact official query-count replay; QA only, not a biological prediction

rows.claim_scope: retrospective WDI GDP snapshot replay QA with descriptive comparator, no prediction or superiority claim
rows.formula: replay latest non-null WDI value from pinned World Bank snapshot and compute residual against the same parsed value
rows.split_policy: retrospective snapshot replay only; no train/test or held-out prediction because the snapshot contains the target field
rows.negative_control: remove or corrupt the latest WDI value and require replay parser failure
rows.falsifier: replay parser cannot recover the pinned latest non-null WDI value
rows.quarantine_reason: snapshot contains the target value; retrospective replay QA only, barred from prediction support

rows.claim_scope: finite witness acceptance count for all promoted v12 theorem rows
rows.formula: predicted accepted cases = theorem inventory rows when finite runner failure_total=0
rows.split_policy: finite replay split generated from theorem registry; negative controls paired per theorem
rows.negative_control: remove a required tuple component and observe rejected stronger reading
rows.falsifier: any finite model case has observed verdict different from expected
rows.quarantine_reason: finite proof-corpus consistency check; not empirical support
